source: 756 “Farm” Team
target: 756 “Turma ‘Farm’”

source: After finalizing the details of the real-world gathering through Madame Hela’s messenger, including the time, place, password, and method of the meeting, Lumian quietly listened to the members of the Academy group exchanging ideas, occasionally joining in the discussion.
target: Postquam per nuntium Dominae Helae omnia singularia conventus–tempus, locum, tessera etiamque modum convocandi–confecit, Lumian tranquille auscultabat membra coetus Academiae, quorundam inter se ideas permutantium, interdum ipsius concipiens in disputationem.

source: With his current mastery of mysticism, he no longer needed to hide his ignorance.
target: Cum praesenti mysticismo dominio, amplius non opus erat suam ignorantiam celare.

source: After a while, Lumian asked if anyone had the potion formula and related ingredients for the Harvest Priest, but the answer was no.
target: Post aliquod temporis, Lumian rogavit utrum quisquam formam potionis atque ingredientia correlata Sacerdoti Messis haberet, sed responsum fuit “non.”

source: He then walked over to another group near the ancient palace’s gate.
target: Deinde ad alium coetum iuxta ianuam antiqui palatii ambulavit.

source: Called the “Farm,” it was a group of Curly‐Haired Baboons Research Society members who enjoyed planting and accumulating wealth.
target: Vocatum “Farm,” erat coetus membrorum Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crispatorum, qui gaudebant in planta faciendis et divitias congregandis.

source: Lumian had once overheard their everyday conversations about how many hectares they had purchased, their plans to save for a ranch, their forest harvests, the effectiveness of their compost, the Church of Earth Mother’s batch of modified wheat seeds suitable for arid regions, their growing savings, and how work brought them joy.
target: Lumian olim auscultaverat cotidiana colloquia eorum de quantis hectaris emptionem fecerint, de consiliis pecuniam ad fundum conservandi, de messe silvestri, de efficacitate compostionis, de copia seminum tritici modificatorum a Ecclesia Matris Terrae aptorum ad regiones aridas, de pecuniis crescentibus atque de gaudio quod opus eis afferebat.

source: After that, Lumian never eavesdropped again.
target: Postea, Lumian numquam iterum furtim auscultavit.

source: As he approached the Farm members, he smelled the earthy scents of soil, fertilizer, grass, grains, and livestock—a familiar and comforting aroma that transported him back to Cordu Village, back to his sister’s side.
target: Dum ad membra “Farm” appropinquabat, olfactus terrae, fertilis, herbae, granorum, et pecorum eum movit ad Vicum Cordu, ad sororis eius latum—aroma notum atque solatorem.

source: The experienced Lumian instantly became alert.
target: Lumian peritus statim alertus factus est.

source: This… reminds me of life in Cordu for one thing, but on another level, the acts of farming, herding, and harvesting resonate with the Omebella bloodline within me.
target: Hoc … mihi memoriam revocat vitae in Cordu ex una parte, sed alio modo opera agriculturae, pecuandi, et messei cum sanguine Omebella in me resonant.

source: The Goddess of Harvest is indeed living up to Her name; as expected of the Great Mother’s Child of God…
target: Dea Messis vere nomini suo congruit; ut exspectatur a prole Magnae Matris Dei…

source: Lumian quickly figured out the reason.
target: Lumian celeriter causam cognovit.

source: Although consuming the remnants of Omebella’s umbilical cord hadn’t enhanced his powers or abilities, it had attracted the Great Mother’s gaze, allowing creatures She had created or blessed to sense his bloodline, though it hadn’t been without effect.
target: Licet edendi reliquias funiculi umbilicalis Omebellae eius potentias nec facultates auxisset, tamen oculum Magnae Matris attraxit, sinens creaturas quas illa creaverat aut benedixerat sanguinem eius percipere, etiamsi hoc non effectu vacuus fuit.

source: Omebella’s residual bloodline subtly altered his perceptions of certain things, indirectly affecting his psyche.
target: Residua stirps sanguinis Omebellae subtiliter mutavit eius perceptiones quorundam rerum, indirecte afficiens animum eius.

source: As Lumian listened to the Farm group members discussing, he keenly observed each person’s reactions.
target: Dum Lumian membra coetus “Farm” disputantia audiebat, perspicue singulorum responsa observavit.

source: Although only creatures lacking necessary intellect would mistake him for a child of the Great Mother, those who had received the Great Mother’s boons or were directly created by Her could sense the Omebella bloodline in him, though they wouldn’t misidentify him.
target: Licet tantum creaturae intellectu carentes eum pro prole Magnae Matris confundere possent, illi vero qui beneficia Magnae Matris acceperant aut a Ea directe creati erant, sanguinem Omebellae in eo percipere poterant, nec eum errone cognoscentes.

source: This would help Lumian determine through any unusual reactions among the Farm group members whether they covertly worshiped the Great Mother.
target: Hoc Lumiano auxilium praebebit ut, ex reactionibus insolitis inter membra “Farm”, intellegat num occulte Magnam Matrem colerent.

source: After a few minutes, Lumian tentatively confirmed that none of the Curly‐Haired Baboons Research Society members in this area were problematic.
target: Post pauca minuta, Lumian tentative confirmavit nullum ex membris Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crispatorum in hac regione esse problematicum.

source: He then mimicked Aurore’s voice when she pressed her voice down, looked around, and asked, “Does anyone have the Harvest Priest’s potion formula or related ingredients? If you’re unwilling to disclose the formula, you could sell me a ready-made Harvest Priest potion.”
target: Deinde, vocem Aurore imitans—cum illa vocem deprimebat et circumiensque aspiciens—rogavit: “Habesne quisquam formulam potionis Sacerdotis Messis aut ingredientia correlata? Si formam non revelare velitis, potesne mihi vendere potionem paratam Sacerdotis Messis?”

source: “Muggle, I thought you were a ‘Warlock,’” a Farm group member called “Breeder Master” asked, puzzled.
target: “Muggle, putabam te esse ‘Warlock’,” inquit membrum coetus “Farm”, qui nominabatur “Magister Fecundator”, perplexus.

source: He was tall with a rugged, wild demeanor and wore a primitive tribal mask made from animal fur.
target: Erat altus, habitu rudo et ferocio, et indutus larva tribalis primitiva ex pelibus animalium facta.

source: “I know someone who needs it,” Lumian laughed, “and I thought I might make a small profit while helping out.”
target: «Scio aliquem cui hoc necessarium sit,» risit Lumian, «et putavi me posse parvum lucrum adipisci simul cum auxilio dando.»

source: Breeder Master further inquired, “You should know that a ready-made potion needs to be consumed quickly before it is absorbed by the container and becomes a Sealed Artifact with strong negative effects. Moreover, trading through Madame Hela’s messenger would delay things. You have to drink it immediately upon receipt. Will there be no issues?”
target: Magister Fecundator interrogavit: “Scire debes potionem paratam celeriter consumi, antequam vas eam absorbeat et fiat Artifactum Signatum cum effectibus negativis validis. Insuper, negotiatio per nuntium Dominae Helae res morabitur; statim eam bibendum est cum recipis. Nonne omnia bene erunt?”

source: Madame Hela’s messenger sure is busy… Lumian teased inwardly. “No problem.”
target: Nuntius Dominae Helae certe valde occupatus est… Lumian intimo iocose dixit: “Nulla quaestio.”

source: After questioning and observing, he was sure that the Doctor potion from Lugano had been fully digested.
target: Postquam quaesivit et observavit, certus fuit potionem “Doctor” ex Lugano plene digestam esse.

source: This was a Doctor who had treated an Angel and fake Angel!
target: Hic erat Doctor, qui Angelum atque Angelum simulatum curaverat!

source: After Ludwig was brutally beaten by Loki, it was Lugano who had treated and healed his wounds.
target: Postquam Ludwig a Loki saevissime verberatus est, Lugano vulnera eius curavit et sanavit.

source: Lumian himself had received Lugano’s treatments on multiple occasions.
target: Lumian ipse pluribus occasionibus curationes Lugani accepit.

source: After contemplating for a moment, Breeder Master said, “20,000 gold risot for a ready-made Harvest Priest potion.”
target: Post brevem meditationem, Magister Fecundator dixit: “20,000 risot aurei pro potione parata Sacerdotis Messis.”

source: “It’s pricier than just buying the ingredients separately, but we have to respect intellectual property rights. Normally, I’d charge between 30,000 and 35,000, but since we’re all members of the society…”
target: “Hoc pretiosius est quam singillatim ingrediens emere, sed oportet iura intellectualis proprietatis observare. Plerumque inter 30,000 et 35,000 exigere possem, sed cum omnes sodales sumus societatis…”

source: About 40,000 verl d’or, Lumian nodded slightly in agreement.
target: Circa 40,000 verl d’or, Lumian leviter annuit consentiens.

source: “No problem.”
target: “Nulla quaestio.”

source: He already had 19,000 gold risot in bills and coins on him, so he made an upfront payment of 10,000, agreeing to pay the balance upon receipt of the potion.
target: Iam 19,000 risot aurei in schedulis et nummis habebat, itaque 10,000 praeposuit, pollicitus reliquum solvere ad recipiendam potionem.

source: They brought in 007 from the Sanctuary group to notarize the agreement.
target: Invocaverunt 007 ex coetu Sanctuarii ad pactum notarizandum.

source: “Pleasure doing business,” said Breeder Master with a smile to Muggle as he pocketed the deposit.
target: “Voluptas negotii,” inquit Magister Fecundator cum risu ad Muggle, dum depositum in sinu suo reponit.

source: He then turned to other members of the Farm group and exclaimed, “Now I have the funds for more experiments! I’ve been studying those mushrooms created by the legendary Druid Frank Lee. I find his philosophy intriguing and worth following.
target: Deinde ad ceteros membra coetus “Farm” conversus exclamavit: “Nunc facultatem habeo ad ulteriora experimenta agendum! Illos fungos, quos creavit druid legendarius Frank Lee, studui; philosophiam eius iucundam atque sequendam puto.

source: “Given the myriad supernatural beings in this world, including Beyonders, why not merge the blood, flesh, milk of these beings with ordinary plants? Whether through hybridization or genetic modification, with the aid of mystical powers, it can be done relatively easily, and after several generations, the traits stabilize, resulting in plants with magical effects but no Beyonder characteristics…”
target: “Propter multitudinem entium supernaturalis in hoc mundo, inter quos Beyonders, cur non sanguinem, carnem, et lac horum cum plantis ordinariis coniungere possimus? Sive per hybridationem sive modificationem geneticam, cum auxilio potestatum mysticarum id facile perferri potest, et post aliquot generationes proprietates stabilis fiunt, efficiendo plantas effectibus magicis sed sine notis Beyonder…”

source: As Lumian listened, a strange unease began to form within him.
target: Dum Lumian audiebat, in eo inchoavit inexplicabilis inquietudo.

source: He never felt this way even when discussing death-related topics with the Purgatory group!
target: Numquam talem sensum habuit, etiam cum de rebus mortis pertinentibus cum coetu Purgatorii dissereret!

source: The first time he heard the name Frank Lee was in the Cordu Village dream, where an official Beyonder named Ryan mentioned a saying that circulated at sea: “I’d rather come face to face with Pirate Admirals or even Kings than run into a bloke named Frank Lee.”
target: Prima vice nomen Frank Lee audivit in somnio Vici Cordu, ubi officialis Beyonder, Ryan, locutus est: “Mallem me conspectu habere cum Admiralis Piratarum aut etiam Regibus, quam incidere cum viro qui ‘Frank Lee’ appellatur.”

source: Later, when Lumian was at sea, he heard no rumors about Frank Lee, nor did he know if Ryan was exaggerating in the dream or if those who knew of Frank Lee’s deeds dared not or chose not to mention him again.
target: Postea, cum Lumian in mari esset, rumores de Frank Lee non audivit, neque scivit an Ryan in somnio exaggeraverit aut an qui de gestis Frank Lee noverant, non ausi aut noluerint eum iterum commemorare.

source: Sanctuary team.
target: Coetus Sanctuarii.

source: Franca looked towards a member nicknamed “Someone” and asked with a smile, “Weren’t you looking for the Marauder pathway Sequence 5 Dream Stealer’s Beyonder characteristic? Still need it? I just got one from a friend.”
target: Franca respexit ad membrum, cui vulgo “Someone” dictus erat, et cum risu rogavit: “Nonne quaerebas proprietatem Beyonder viae Marauder, Sequenciae 5 Dream Stealer? An tamen opus est? Modo ab amico unum accepi.”

source: “If you don’t want it, I’ll go to an Artisan to craft a mystical item with that Beyonder characteristic.”
target: “Si id non vis, ad Artificem ibo ut rem mysticam cum illa proprietate Beyonder conficiam.”

source: Someone, wearing an eyepatch-style black half-face mask, sized up Franca and replied, “It seems your friend isn’t you.”
target: “Someone,” indutus larva nigrae semi–faciei, Francam aestimavit et respondit: “Videtur amicus tuus non esse tu.”

source: “I don’t need it anymore, but wouldn’t mind another.”
target: “Iam non mihi opus est, sed alterum bene acciperem.”

source: “One flat rate, 5000 pounds.”
target: “Unum pretium fixum, 5000 librarum.”

source: That’s about 120,000 verl d’or… Franca laughed and said, “200,000 verl d’or, not a coin less.”
target: Id fere est 120,000 verl d’or… Franca risit et inquit: “200,000 verl d’or, nec nummus minus.”

source: Someone calculated for a moment and countered, “150,000 verl d’or at best, or forget it.”
target: “Someone” paulisper computavit et dixit: “Optime 150,000 verl d’or, aut omitte.”

source: Franca thought for a few seconds and said, “You can pay in two installments, the first right now of 120,000 verl d’or, and the second of 60,000 within three months of receiving the Beyonder characteristic, secured by 007’s notarization to enforce the contract.”
target: Franca paulisper meditata, dixit: “Potes solvere in duas stipulationes: primam nunc 120,000 verl d’or, et secundam 60,000 intra tres menses ab obtinendo proprietate Beyonder, sub notarizatio 007 ad pactum confirmandum.”

source: Someone paused to think, then asked with a smile, “Aren’t you worried I’ll default after getting the Beyonder characteristic? A Notary’s notarization isn’t foolproof, remember, I was once a renowned Swindler.”
target: “Someone” paulisper suspensa cogitavit et, cum risu, rogavit: “Nonne timebis me deficere postquam proprietatem Beyonder accepero? Notarii notarizatio non est infallibilis, memento, olim fama fraudatoris mihi aderat.”

source: Franca smiled. “Who’s better, you or Bard?”
target: Franca subridet: “Quis melior est, tu an Bard?”

source: Someone fell silent.
target: “Someone” tacuit.

source: “Bard has already been dealt with by me and my comrades. Unless you’re willing to give up a very useful trading platform over 60,000 verl d’or, I’m not worried about you defaulting, your Beyonder characteristics are also quite valuable.” Franca, who had mafia ties, made her intimidating remark as casually as discussing what’s for dinner.
target: “Bard iam a me et sociis meis tractatus est. Nisi paratus es tradere suggestum commercii valde utilem pro 60,000 verl d’or, non timeo te deficere; proprietates Beyonder tuae quoque sunt pretiosissimae.”

source: “It won’t be long before I surpass him,” replied Someone after a few seconds, “Deal!”
target: “Non multum erit antequam eum superem,” respondit “Someone” post paucos secundos, “Pactum!”

source: “No rush,” Franca said with a smile, “The final payment must be in gold.”
target: “Nulla festinatio,” inquit Franca cum risu, “ultima solutio in auro esse debet.”

source: In the following days, Lumian had no particular business and wandered around Trier, tracking several Mirror People and looking for Harrison’s whereabouts based on intelligence provided by 007.
target: In diebus posthac, Lumian negotium singulare non habebat et per Trier errabat, persequens nonnullos Homines Speculares atque quaerens locum Harrison ex informationibus a 007 datis.

source: He was supposed to collect a reward from Mr. K, but his heart resisted, and he kept delaying.
target: Eum exspectabat ut mercedem a Domine K colligeret, sed cor eius repugnavit atque moraturus permanevit.

source: Franca completed her transaction with Someone from the Sanctuary group, receiving a down payment composed of bills and coins totaling 5000 pounds.
target: Franca mercaturam suam cum “Someone” ex coetu Sanctuarii perfecit, accipiens solutionem initialem ex schedulis et nummis quae totaliter 5000 librarum constabant.

source: She also gave Jenna 15,000 verl d’or in bills, stipulating that the remaining payment of 60,000 verl d’or in gold belonged entirely to her.
target: Ea etiam Jennae 15,000 verl d’or in schedulis dedit, statuens quod reliqua solutio de 60,000 verl d’or in auro ad eam omnino pertineret.

source: Jenna lost the Dream Stealer Beyonder characteristic but also paid off the 45,000 verl d’or she owed Franca, now possessing 16,000 verl d’or and gold Loen pound worth 120,000 verl d’or.
target: Jenna proprietatem Beyonder Dream Stealer amisit, sed simul 45,000 verl d’or, quos Francae debebat, solvit, atque nunc possidet 16,000 verl d’or et libram auri Loen valoris 120,000 verl d’or.

source: She had never been so wealthy before.
target: Numquam antea tam dives fuisset.

source: She always knew that potion formulas and Beyonder characteristics were valuable and even knew their approximate price range, but she had never paid in full in one go nor truly sold any until now.
target: Semper sciebat formulas potionum et proprietates Beyonder pretiosas esse atque etiam earum pretium circiter cognovisset, sed numquam totum solutum nec vere venditum fecerat usque ad hunc diem.

source: Now she was experiencing what it felt like to earn money like the Pirate Hunter Gehrman Sparrow.
target: Nunc experiebatur quomodo esset argentum mereri sicut Piratarum Venator Gehrman Sparrow.

source: That evening, just as Lumian returned to his rented apartment planning to change his clothes and muster the courage to see Mr. K, the wall lamp in his room suddenly tinged with eerie green and pale colors.
target: Illo vespera, cum Lumian ad conductum suum rediret, consilium habens vestimenta mutare et animos colligere ut Dominum K videat, lucerna parietalis in cella eius subito viridi obscuro atque pallidis coloribus tincta est.

source: They blended bizarrely together.
target: Inusitate simul miscebantur.

source: Then, Lumian saw his messenger, the mummified Penitent in a black clergy robe, emerge from the void.
target: Tum Lumian vidit nuntium suum, Penitentem mummificatum in veste clericali nigra, ex nihilo emergere.

source: Almost simultaneously, Madame Hela’s messenger, a skull made of pure silver, appeared shrouded in darkness.
target: Fere simul, nuntius Dominae Helae—calvaria ex argento puro facta—apparuit in tenebris involuta.

source: Shortly after, the silhouette of a doll messenger rapidly took shape.
target: Post breve intervallum, umbra nuntii pupae celeriter formam cepit.

source: Lumian was somewhat stunned.
target: Lumian paulo stupefactus fuit.

source: Would the messengers fight each other?
target: Num nuntii inter se pugnabunt?

source: Do! have three letters?
target: “Do!” tres litteras habet?

source: One should be for the Harvest Priest potion, another likely a Sealed Artifact made from the Beyonder characteristics of Hisoka, but what about the third?
target: Unum ad potionem Sacerdotis Messis pertineat, alter probabiliter ad Artifactum Signatum ex proprietatibus Beyonder Hisokae, sed quid de tertio?
